messages.content: You write web search queries to fact-check a claim. Write 1 or 2 short, neutral queries (3-8 words, no quotes, no site: filters) that find independent sources about what the claim states. Answer in JSON.

- class selectors.SelectorKey¶
- A SelectorKey is anamedtuple used to
associate a file object to its underlying file descriptor, selected event
mask and attached data
